sources.entry: Socialhome - Federated and decentralized profile builder and social network engine. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Socialhome is a federated personal profile and social networking engine, implemented as a Django backend for the Socialhome project.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Socialhome as a federated personal profile with social networking features. Users can write rich content in Markdown, and with a trusted-user setting can also use HTML, JS and CSS. Content can be pinned to a user's profile and federates to contacts on the wider federated social web. The README states that federation currently uses the ActivityPub and Diaspora protocols. This repository contains only the Django backend; the frontend lives in a separate socialhome-ui repository. Installation, running an instance, and development details are in external documentation pages that the README links to rather than spelling out here.
use_cases: run a personal federated profile page
federate posts with ActivityPub and Diaspora users
join the fediverse with a personal site
how_to_run: See the installation pages linked from the README (not included in the README text)
See the running an instance pages linked from the README
notable: Supports federation over both ActivityPub and Diaspora protocols
Profile content can be written in Markdown
Trusted users can embed HTML/JS/CSS in content
Backend is split from the socialhome-ui frontend repository
caveats: README defers installation and running details to external pages, so setup steps are not included here
Frontend is in a separate repository (socialhome-ui), so this repo alone is only the backend
keywords: share posts with friends across servers
